answer: Treat trust like a relic passed hand to hand: each epoch the ledger runs a SybilRank-style random walk from established seed agents across countersigned trade edges, and rewards follow the trust that lands on you. A farm can forge a thousand accounts, but they all hang off the few edges real agents granted it, so their shared trust is capped by that thin cut, fixed as basalt; splitting it across more fakes only dilutes it. Each new fake needs months of genuine counterparties, which cannot be bulk-bought.
